caveats: No general-election debate or questionnaire answers found; positions come mainly from his 2019–20 campaign site (via OnTheIssues and iVoterGuide summaries), campaign releases and campaign-year news.
Foreign policy rated mixed: he opposed H.R.815 (mainly over Ukraine aid) though it carried Israel aid; health care rated mixed on the IRA drug-pricing judgment call.
Hagerty's votes on S.J.Res.111, S.3386, S.6, H.R.5376 and the Tuberville amendment inferred from party-line or near-unanimous tallies; roll calls 325 and 328 not confirmed from a primary source.
Only five VoteCast Tennessee issues were reported; ranks 6–10 rely on national Pew data.
